newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian federally owned telecom Telebras but lowering its forecasts for the company's 1996 and 1997 earnings.
-- The brokerage said it reduced its 1996 earnings estimate on its American Depositary Receipts (ADR) to $8 per ADR from $8.30 and its 1997 forecast to $11.30 per ADR from $12.15.
-- Patrimonio said it is lowering its estimates for the firm due to Telebras' voluntary retirement program, asset writeoffs and slightly lower than expected growth.
-- But it added the firm still trades at about half the average for its Latin American peers and at a 20-percent discount on a sum-of-the-parts valuation of the firm.
-- Telebras preferred was up 0.20 reais at 80.00 reais at 1405 local/1105 EST on the Sao Paulo bourse and its ADR was up 3/8 at 77-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange.
